title: api: add structured_output JSON schema support (response_format, validation, strict mode, OpenAI compatibility)
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation: Add first-class JSON schema support to the structured_output API surface so callers can declare expected shapes (like OpenAI 'response_format' + json schema). This enables server-side validation, better error messages, and a strict mode that fails when the model output cannot be coerced to the schema.

What this PR does: Implements a response_format=json_schema option and schema validation pipeline across the API and the OpenAI compatibility layer. Adds a 'strict' enforcement flag. Provides structured validation errors with clear codes and hint messages for downstream SDKs to bubble up.

Checklist:
- [x] API parameter parsing and validation (response_format + schema + strict)
- [x] Server-side schema validation implementation (fast, streaming-friendly)
- [x] OpenAI-compat mapping for schema requests and error shape
- [x] SDK surface smoke tests (python/ts)
commits: feat(api): add response_format=json_schema handler and parse incoming schema payload
feat(runtime): integrate streaming schema validator into tokenizer/stream pipeline
chore(openai-compat): map response_format+schema to internal structured_output flow
test: add unit + integration tests for schema validation, strict mode and error codes
docs: document new response_format, validation errors and best practices
changes_summary: Add response_format parsing on API level and new request shape validation
Streaming-friendly JSON schema validator that validates per-chunk and composes result
Introduce SchemaValidationError with machine-readable code and user message
OpenAI compatibility: accept 'response_format: { type: "json_schema", schema: ... }' and return compatible error shapes
SDKs: add helpers to pass schema and handle structured validation errors with suggestions
Docs + examples and CI pipeline to run schema-validator unit tests
review_comments: Aisha Carter: Overall looks good. Two requests: please add a perf test for large schemas, and ensure we don't buffer full responses in memory in streaming validator.

Priya Menon: Added perf microbenchmarks (service/runtime/bench/schema_bench.rs) and refactored validator to be incremental; tests added. See commit feat(runtime): integrate streaming schema validator.
Miguel Torres: We should ensure OpenAI-compat errors match expected fields (type, message, param). Please add mapping tests.
Priya Menon: Added mapping tests and updated compat_layer.rs to emit openai_compat::Error { type, message, param, code } shape. Tests in tests/integration/test_structured_output.py
Eve Zhang: Minor docs nit: add example for 'strict: true' behavior and explain rollback/fallback behavior when validation fails mid-stream.
Priya Menon: Docs updated with strict mode examples and recommended fallback: return latest valid fallback object or emit SchemaValidationError with 'partial_output' field to help clients.
testing_notes: Added unit tests for positive and negative schema cases
Integration test covers streaming case where model emits extraneous tokens that must be ignored/coerced
Added fuzz harness for malformed schema inputs to catch edge cases
SDK smoke tests verify error shapes and helper coercion logic
error_handling: SchemaValidationError: code=SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED, message explains which paths failed
StrictModeError: code=STRICT_MODE_VIOLATION, emitted when strict=true and output cannot be coerced
PartialOutputWarning: code=PARTIAL_OUTPUT_EMITTED, returned when partial valid object can be reconstructed
Compatibility: OpenAI-compat returns 'error': { 'type': <code>, 'message': <user-facing>, 'param': 'response_format' } for validation failures
backwards_compatibility: Default behavior unchanged when response_format is not provided (existing streaming/text paths remain)
When clients pass a legacy OpenAI style 'response_format': 'json_schema', compat layer translates to new structured_output route
Non-strict validation returns best-effort coercion and a validation-warnings header to preserve existing integrations
release_notes: Added server-side JSON Schema support for structured output. New request parameter response_format=json_schema lets callers provide a schema and optional strict=true flag. Server validates model output (streaming-friendly), returns structured SchemaValidationError/StrictModeError with machine codes, and maps errors to OpenAI-compat shapes for SDK interoperability. Non-strict mode attempts coercion and returns validation warnings. See docs/api/structured_output.md for examples and migration guidance.
